This corridor, which offers hassle-free access for pilgrims, was shut down following security alerts linked to Operation Sindoor. Shah highlighted the need to keep national security discussions free from political influences, while also pointing out that the corridor's placement in Pakistan stemmed from Congress party oversights during partition.

title: NSA Ajit Doval, Maldives defence minister discuss security ties at Colombo meet
description: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval and Maldives defense minister Hassan Rasheed discussed security cooperation at the Colombo Security Conclave. This meeting marked the first high-level interaction between the two countries since President Mohamed Muizzu's recent visit to Pakistan. During that visit, Maldives signed 20 agreements with Pakistan related to defense and maritime issues. Additionally, Muizzu called for resuming the Saarc summit process to enhance regional cooperation.

title: Utah banker mailed 37 tons of bricks to build a bank, forcing postal rule changes
description: In 1916, the directors of the Bank of Vernal needed bricks for a new building project. They faced high transportation costs due to poor road conditions in rural Utah. A director discovered that shipping bricks by postal service was a cheaper option, allowing many small packages to be sent. This unique approach led to changes in postal regulations regarding large shipments.

title: Scientists discover 5-million-year-old coral atoll hidden 900 metres underwater
description: A groundbreaking expedition has unveiled a submerged coral atoll in the Romanche Fracture Zone that dates back five million years. This undersea marvel is home to exquisite sponge gardens and ancient corals that are around 1,000 years old. Scientists have explored ecosystems at depths ranging from 600 to 4,300 metres, revealing significant ecological value and potential contributions to marine conservation under the High Seas Treaty.

title: Around 1,000 books, 3 libraries: How Telangana police are helping tribal job aspirants

With approximately 1,000 books tailored for various government recruitment exams, including UPSC and DSC, local gram panchayats partnered with the police to create these facilities. This initiative aims to empower local youth in their pursuit of government jobs, eliminating the need for extensive travel.

title: Acres of Florida ranchland could become wildlife corridor habitat or solar farm

With property appraisals due by December 15, conservationists are emphasizing the site's importance for wildlife connectivity and habitat preservation, raising the stakes for both ecological health and development plans.
